title: Grilled Jamaican Snapper
description: A Caribbean-inspired dish featuring pan-seared snapper seasoned with Jamaican spices.
instructions: Rinse snapper fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
Season snapper with Jamaican Jerk Seasoning, making sure to coat both sides evenly.
If using lightly battered breading, coat snapper fillets with breading, pressing gently to adhere.
Brush grill grates with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill snapper fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove snapper from grill and place on a serving platter.
Squeeze lime wedges over snapper and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, with additional lime wedges on the side.
